central_object: Learning reusable procedural behavior together with scope-, evidence-, authority-, version- and verifier-sensitive warrant sufficient for held-out reuse and later retain/revalidate/retract/abstain decisions.

supported_theorem_layers.statement: For M lifecycle response profiles, min(C,B)+Q+a >= ceil(log2 M).
Lifecycle equivalence strictly refines current behavior; warrant correctness and model unlearning are incomparable; composition does not amplify authority without a bridge certificate.

Positive-only open-world support cannot guarantee exact sound and retention-complete repair; general implicit RETAIN is NP-complete and RETRACT coNP-complete; explicit complete support manifests give tractable parent-owned maintenance.
Endpoint-only < raw trace < positive certified support < closure-certified warrant is a strict lifecycle-identifiability hierarchy on the registered modular family.

decisive_next_theorem.name: Natural-Class Warrant Compilation Frontier
decisive_next_theorem.required_statement: For a natural class of compositional learned procedures with implicit, scope-bound support relations, prove a tight computational/query/communication trade-off among certified acquisition, compiled warrant state, held-out recombination, future revalidation, procedural recourse, abstention, false retention and useful retention under equal-information strongest-parent comparison.
decisive_next_theorem.required_upper_witness: Output-sensitive learner and repair algorithm with independently checkable local certificates.
decisive_next_theorem.required_lower_witness: Non-cardinality lower bound after giving the comparator identical observations, verifier access, memory and update sequence.
decisive_next_theorem.architecture_test: Compile the algorithm into an equally provisioned recurrent Transformer and contract to an interface theorem if compilation succeeds.

natural target class replacing direct hidden bits

reopen_or_contract.contract_to_parent_sufficient_if: A reconstructed parent or faithful parent product entails the strict hierarchy and natural-class frontier under equal information and resources.
